data.name: get_patterns
data.text:
## card — Card (component, archetype browse-collections)
A bounded container that summarizes one item; the most common item view inside overviews.
Aliases: tile, item card
Anatomy: Media (Image or video); Header (Title and subtitle); Body (Key attributes); Actions (What can be done to the item)
Related — uses: badge, menu | neighbors: stat-tile
Dimensions (dims key = sub-dimension id; values = value ids):
* Card content [content] — What goes on the card?
  - media (single-select: one id) — Media
      none: None (e.g. Linear issue cards)
      top-image: Top image (e.g. Airbnb listings)
      side-thumbnail: Side thumbnail (e.g. Spotify search results)
      full-bleed-background: Full-bleed background (e.g. App Store Today cards)
  - actions (single-select: one id) — Actions
      none: None — The card only opens (e.g. News cards)
      one-primary-action: One primary action (e.g. Add to cart on a product card)
      action-row: Action row (e.g. Social post actions)
      overflow-menu: Overflow menu (e.g. Google Drive file cards)
* Form [layout] — What shape and weight does the card take?
  - shape (single-select: one id) — Shape
      vertical: Vertical (e.g. Product grids)
      horizontal: Horizontal (e.g. Search result rows)
      compact-tile: Compact tile (e.g. Home screen widgets)
  - style (single-select: one id) — Container style
      elevated: Elevated (e.g. Material 3 elevated card)
      filled: Filled (e.g. Material 3 filled card)
      outlined: Outlined (e.g. Material 3 outlined card)
      borderless: Borderless — No container at all: no fill, no border and no shadow — the media and text sit directly on the page background and the card is defined only by its grouping and spacing. The default for most modern consumer overviews, and not expressible with Material's three container styles (e.g. Airbnb — Listing card in search results)
* Target [invocation] — Which part of the card opens the item?
  - target (single-select: one id) — Tap target
      whole-card: Whole card (e.g. Airbnb)
      title-only: Title only (e.g. Search results)
      separate-targets-per-attribute: Separate targets per attribute — Thumbnail opens a gallery, title opens the page (e.g. Meridian openFrom)

## banner — Banner (component, archetype monitor)
A persistent message across a region or page about a condition that needs attention.
Aliases: inline alert, callout, system banner, notice
Anatomy: Message (The condition); Severity (How serious); Action (What to do); Dismiss (Whether it can go away)
Related — neighbors: toast, empty-state
Dimensions (dims key = sub-dimension id; values = value ids):
* Scope [scope] — What does the condition apply to?
  - scope (single-select: one id) — Scope
      whole-app: Whole app (e.g. Service outage banners)
      page: Page (e.g. Account warnings)
      section: Section (e.g. GOV.UK error summary)
      field: Field (e.g. Inline field notices)
* Severity [feedback] — How serious is it?
  - severity (single-select: one id) — Severity
      information: Information (e.g. Scheduled maintenance)
      success: Success (e.g. Settings saved)
      warning: Warning (e.g. Card expiring)
      critical: Critical (e.g. Payment failed)
* Dismissal [lifecycle] — Can it go away?
  - dismissal (single-select: one id) — Dismissal
      not-until-resolved: Not until resolved (e.g. Verification required)
      dismissible: Dismissible (e.g. Announcements)
      returns-later: Returns later (e.g. Update reminders)
      clears-with-the-condition: Clears with the condition (e.g. Connectivity banners)
* Action [content] — Does it offer a way to fix things?
  - action (single-select: one id) — Action
      none: None (e.g. Maintenance notices)
      link-to-fix: Link to fix (e.g. Update payment method)
      primary-action: Primary action (e.g. Restart to update)
      several-actions: Several actions (e.g. Cookie consent)
* Placement [layout] — Where does it sit?
  - placement (single-select: one id) — Placement
